context: Merchant management and QRIS payment mobile prototype for Indonesian UMKM/stores
ui_features: Outlet selector dropdown with multi-outlet support
Live Balance card with privacy hide toggle & instant withdraw simulation
Quick actions: Buat QRIS, Cek Mutasi, Tarik Saldo, Riwayat
FAB QRIS center button opening dynamic/static QRIS generator with sound notification toggle
Promo carousel (non-intrusif tips & UMKM growth programs)
Recent transactions list with status badges
Riwayat screen with date filter, status filter, search, and export CSV simulation
Analisa screen with insight cards, stats, bar chart preview, and top outlets
Kelola Pegawai CRUD with full validation form (tambah, edit, hapus, role management: Kasir/Supervisor)
Profil merchant with verification status, store info, and settings
Pusat Notifikasi & In-app guidance in Bahasa Indonesia with sound alert simulation
Informative empty, error, and retry states across tabs
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Always use data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modals).
Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG contrast standards.
Use Bahasa Indonesia for all UI labels, empty states, and notification messages.
Provide smooth tab switching and modal dialogs with Shadcn primitives.
No cash/PPOB features included as per strict requirements.
Support responsive preview inside a clean mobile frame with outer background.
